_comment: Copy thanh config.live.json va sua. Che do mac dinh dry_run: an toan, khong can key.
_daily_note: Dung MO VI THE MOI khi lo thuc te trong ngay (UTC) < -20% portfolio dau ngay. Vi the cu van duoc quan ly exit.
_exit_note: Exit ladder mirror y het paper (radar.py plan scalp): TP1 +50% ban 1/3, TP2 +100% ban them 1/3, con lai trailing -30% tu dinh; SL -25% cat het; smart exit khi >=2 vi tracked xa cung token/30p; time stop 480p (lai >=20% -> chot 1/2 giu 1/2 trailing, khong thi cat het).
_fee_buffer_note: Giu lai toi thieu 0.02 SOL trong vi cho phi tx + rent, khong dung de swap.
_impact_note: Bo qua lenh neu price impact vuot nguong, don vi PHAN TRAM (5.0 = 5%). Jupiter tra priceImpactPct dang phan so (0.05 = 5%), code tu quy doi.
_jupiter_note: lite-api.jup.ag dang bi giam rate va se khai tu. Tao API key (developers.jup.ag) -> env JUPITER_API_KEY hoac file .jupiter_key (chmod 600): bot tu chuyen sang https://api.jup.ag va gui header x-api-key. Khong co key ma dung api.jup.ag: gioi han 0.5 req/s -> dat jupiter_min_interval_seconds = 2.
_key_note: Private key base58: dat trong env SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY (nap tu file .env chmod 600, uu tien) hoac file .solana_key chmod 600. KHONG commit, KHONG paste vao chat.
_mode_note: dry_run = chi log y dinh swap, KHONG gui transaction, khong can key. live = swap THAT bang tien that, bat buoc co key (env/file) va pubkey khop wallet_address (thieu -> tu dung).
_preflight_note: false = mo phong tx truoc khi gui (an toan hon, cham hon). true = gui thang (nhanh hon, rui ro hon).
_priority_note: Phi uu tien co dinh moi tx (20000 lamports = 0.00002 SOL). Hoac dang auto: {"auto": true, "max_lamports": 1000000, "level": "veryHigh"}.
_size_note: So USD moi lenh mua (paper dung tiers theo mcap; live test dung flat $10 cho don gian va an toan).
_slippage_note: 100 bps = 1%. Meme bien dong manh: 100-300 la hop ly. Cao hon = de bi front-run/sandwich.
_signal_age_note: Bo qua signal cu hon max_signal_age_seconds (tinh tu ts giao dich cua vi nguon). Ap dung ca backlog sau restart va retry. Can dong ho may radar va VPS dong bo (NTP).
_safety_note: Truoc khi mua: doc mint qua RPC (fail closed) -> bo token con freeze/mint authority hoac extension Token-2022 nguy hiem; quote thu ban lai luong token se nhan: khong co route -> no_sell_route, lo khu hoi > max_round_trip_loss_pct (%) -> round_trip. Chong mua duoi: gia minh cao hon gia vi nguon khop > max_entry_premium_pct (%) -> chase. Signal bi tu choi ghi skipped_<ly do>, dem trong live_state.json entry_rejects. 0 = tat tung kiem tra.
_rent_note: Ban sach token -> dong token account so du 0, lay lai rent ~0.00204 SOL (lenh $10 la ~3%). Rent cua lan mua dau duoc tach khoi gia vao (rent_lamports). Account rong ton tu truoc: python close_empty_accounts.py (liet ke) roi --yes.
_escalation_note: SL/TRAIL/SMART_EXIT/COPY_EXIT/TIME ban that bai chac chan (impact/no route/tx fail) -> vong sau thu lai NGAY voi bac ke tiep (slippage/impact/phi uu tien cao hon). TP khong nang bac.
_price_note: Gia moi vi the qua 1 request Jupiter Price API v3. Token Jupiter khong co gia tin cay -> quote rieng, gian cach price_fallback_seconds.
_copy_exit_note: Vi nguon (vi minh copy) ban cong don >= copy_exit_min_sold_frac luong dang giu -> ban het theo. Nguon: alert wallet_sell cua radar (can radar ban moi).
